WITH file_term_counts AS (
    SELECT
        hc.id AS context_id,
        (
            COUNT(DISTINCT wc.word_id) +
            COUNT(DISTINCT kh.keyword_id)
        )::int AS term_count
    FROM hash_contexts hc
    LEFT JOIN words_hashs wh ON wh.hash_id = hc.hash_id
    LEFT JOIN words_categorys wc ON wc.word_id = wh.word_id
    LEFT JOIN keywords_hashs kh ON kh.hash_id = hc.hash_id
    GROUP BY hc.id
)
SELECT
    p.id AS id,
    p.file_name AS name,
    p.file_type AS type,
    s.name AS source,
    p.file_date AS date,
    si.name AS side,
    p.file_status AS status,
    LEFT(COALESCE(cr.content, ''), 70) AS snippet,
    COALESCE(ftc.term_count, 0) AS matched_terms_count,
    COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM paths p
JOIN hash_contexts hc ON hc.id = p.context_id
LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = hc.source_id
LEFT JOIN sides si ON si.id = hc.side_id
LEFT JOIN contents_raw cr ON cr.hash_id = hc.hash_id AND cr.chunk_seq = 0
LEFT JOIN file_term_counts ftc ON ftc.context_id = hc.id
WHERE (%(file_type)s::text IS NULL OR %(file_type)s = '' OR p.file_type = %(file_type)s)
  AND (
      %(mfq)s::text IS NULL
      OR %(mfq)s = ''
      OR p.file_name ILIKE '%%' || %(mfq)s || '%%'
      OR s.name ILIKE '%%' || %(mfq)s || '%%'
      OR si.name ILIKE '%%' || %(mfq)s || '%%'
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM contents_raw cr_search
          WHERE cr_search.hash_id = hc.hash_id
            AND cr_search.content ILIKE '%%' || %(mfq)s || '%%'
      )
  )
ORDER BY p.date_creation DESC, p.id DESC

WITH file_term_counts AS (
    SELECT
        hc.id AS context_id,
        (
            COUNT(DISTINCT wc.word_id) +
            COUNT(DISTINCT kh.keyword_id)
        )::int AS term_count
    FROM hash_contexts hc
    LEFT JOIN words_hashs wh ON wh.hash_id = hc.hash_id
    LEFT JOIN words_categorys wc ON wc.word_id = wh.word_id
    LEFT JOIN keywords_hashs kh ON kh.hash_id = hc.hash_id
    GROUP BY hc.id
)
SELECT
    p.id AS id,
    p.file_name AS name,
    p.file_type AS type,
    s.name AS source,
    p.file_date AS date,
    si.name AS side,
    p.file_status AS status,
    LEFT(COALESCE(cr.content, ''), 70) AS snippet,
    COALESCE(ftc.term_count, 0) AS matched_terms_count,
    COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM paths p
JOIN hash_contexts hc ON hc.id = p.context_id
LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = hc.source_id
LEFT JOIN sides si ON si.id = hc.side_id
LEFT JOIN contents_raw cr ON cr.hash_id = hc.hash_id AND cr.chunk_seq = 0
LEFT JOIN file_term_counts ftc ON ftc.context_id = hc.id
WHERE (NULL::text IS NULL OR NULL = '' OR p.file_type = NULL)
  AND (
      NULL::text IS NULL
      OR NULL = ''
      OR p.file_name ILIKE '%' || NULL || '%'

      OR si.name ILIKE '%' || NULL || '%'
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM contents_raw cr_search
          WHERE cr_search.hash_id = hc.hash_id
            AND cr_search.content ILIKE '%' || NULL || '%'
      )
  )
ORDER BY p.date_creation DESC, p.id DESC

WITH f AS (
    SELECT p.id            AS path_id,
           p.file_type     AS file_type,
           p.processing_status AS processing_status,
           hc.hash_id      AS hash_id,
           hc.source_id    AS source_id,
           hc.side_id      AS side_id,
           s.name          AS source_name,
           sd.name         AS side_name
    FROM paths p
    LEFT JOIN hash_contexts hc ON hc.id = p.context_id
    LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = hc.source_id
    LEFT JOIN sides sd ON sd.id = hc.side_id
    WHERE (%(source_id)s::int IS NULL OR hc.source_id = %(source_id)s::int)
      AND (%(side_id)s::int IS NULL OR hc.side_id = %(side_id)s::int)
      AND (%(date_from)s::date IS NULL OR p.date_creation >= %(date_from)s::date)
      AND (%(date_to)s::date IS NULL OR p.date_creation <= %(date_to)s::date)
      AND (%(time_from)s::time IS NULL
           OR p.status_updated_at IS NOT NULL
          AND p.status_updated_at::time >= %(time_from)s::time)
      AND (%(time_to)s::time IS NULL
           OR p.status_updated_at IS NOT NULL
          AND p.status_updated_at::time <= %(time_to)s::time)
), totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(success)s)) AS success,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(partial)s)) AS partial,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(failed)s))  AS failed,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(skipped)s)) AS skipped
    FROM f
), by_type AS (
    SELECT file_type,
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(success)s)) AS success,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(partial)s)) AS partial,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(failed)s))  AS failed,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(%(skipped)s)) AS skipped
    FROM f
    GROUP BY file_type
), classifications AS (
    SELECT c.id  AS category_id,
           w.word AS category_term,
           COUNT(DISTINCT x.path_id) AS paths
    FROM f x
    JOIN words_hashs wh ON wh.hash_id = x.hash_id
    JOIN words_categorys wc ON wc.word_id = wh.word_id
    JOIN categorys c ON c.id = wc.category_id
    JOIN words w ON w.id = c.word_id
    GROUP BY c.id, w.word
), keywords AS (
    -- ``keywords.keyword`` is a packed list of word ids, not text: a keyword
    -- here is a phrase. The facet is grouped by id; the phrase is decoded in
    -- Python for the bounded top-N (see ``attach_keyword_phrases``).
    SELECT kh.keyword_id AS keyword_id, COUNT(DISTINCT x.path_id) AS paths
    FROM f x
    JOIN keywords_hashs kh ON kh.hash_id = x.hash_id
    GROUP BY kh.keyword_id
), by_source AS (
    SELECT source_id, source_name, COUNT(*) AS paths
    FROM f WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY source_id, source_name
), by_side AS (
    SELECT side_id, side_name, COUNT(*) AS paths
    FROM f WHERE side_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY side_id, side_name
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'totals', (SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM totals t),
    'by_file_type', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(bt) ORDER BY bt.file_type)

    'classifications', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cls) ORDER BY cls.category_term)

    'keywords', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(kw) ORDER BY kw.paths DESC,

    'sources', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(bs) ORDER BY bs.source_name)

    'sides', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(bd) ORDER BY bd.side_name)
                       FROM by_side bd), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS report

WITH f AS (

           s.name          AS source_name,
           sd.name         AS side_name
    FROM paths p
    LEFT JOIN hash_contexts hc ON hc.id = p.context_id
    LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = hc.source_id
    LEFT JOIN sides sd ON sd.id = hc.side_id
    WHERE (NULL::int IS NULL OR hc.source_id = NULL::int)
      AND (NULL::int IS NULL OR hc.side_id = NULL::int)
      AND (NULL::date IS NULL OR p.date_creation >= NULL::date)
      AND (NULL::date IS NULL OR p.date_creation <= NULL::date)
      AND (NULL::time IS NULL
           OR p.status_updated_at IS NOT NULL
          AND p.status_updated_at::time >= NULL::time)
      AND (NULL::time IS NULL
           OR p.status_updated_at IS NOT NULL
          AND p.status_updated_at::time <= NULL::time)
), totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['processed'])) AS success,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['partially_processed'])) AS partial,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['failed']))  AS failed,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['unsupported','skipped'])) AS skipped
    FROM f
), by_type AS (
    SELECT file_type,
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['processed'])) AS success,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['partially_processed'])) AS partial,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['failed']))  AS failed,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processing_status = ANY(ARRAY['unsupported','skipped'])) AS skipped
    FROM f
    GROUP BY file_type
), classifications AS (
    SELECT c.id  AS category_id,
           w.word AS category_term,
           COUNT(DISTINCT x.path_id) AS paths
    FROM f x
    JOIN words_hashs wh ON wh.hash_id = x.hash_id
    JOIN words_categorys wc ON wc.word_id = wh.word_id
    JOIN categorys c ON c.id = wc.category_id
    JOIN words w ON w.id = c.word_id
    GROUP BY c.id, w.word
), keywords AS (
    -- ``keywords.keyword`` is a packed list of word ids, not text: a keyword
    -- here is a phrase. The facet is grouped by id; the phrase is decoded in
    -- Python for the bounded top-N (see ``attach_keyword_phrases``).
    SELECT kh.keyword_id AS keyword_id, COUNT(DISTINCT x.path_id) AS paths
    FROM f x
    JOIN keywords_hashs kh ON kh.hash_id = x.hash_id
    GROUP BY kh.keyword_id
), by_source AS (
    SELECT source_id, source_name, COUNT(*) AS paths
    FROM f WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY source_id, source_name
), by_side AS (
    SELECT side_id, side_name, COUNT(*) AS paths
    FROM f WHERE side_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY side_id, side_name
)
